question: The Union Territory of Puducherry is located in which of the following river basins?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kaveri River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Union Territory of **Puducherry** is predominantly located in the **Kaveri River Basin**.
 
• **Kaveri** is one of the major rivers in southern India and flows through the states of **Karnataka** and **Tamil Nadu** before emptying into the **Bay of Bengal**.
